desc: Prove that the degree-4 vertices of any alkane form a nonempty connected subtree of the original tree, and that every core vertex must have original degree at least 4.
Prove that a connected core of \(k\) vertices can always be completed with leaves and has \(2k+2\) leaves and \(3k+2\) total vertices.
Derive the maximum connected high-degree subtree DP with core degree at most 4, including rooted and global transitions.
Design an iterative postorder implementation in \(O(N)\) time and \(O(N)\) memory.
Verify the algorithm on all samples and edge cases, then produce the final Python solution with the required delimiters.
